description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Kothmale, Nuwara-Eliya, Walapane, Pradeshiya Sabhas has Vacated his/her Office of member
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of various Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which includes matters concerning electoral boundaries, candidate registrations, and declarations about elected officials.
